A quick path to high-speed LTE

Meet the TCL IK41, our 4G LTE Cat-4 dongle that gives any device with a USB port fast, plug-and-play cellular connectivity. No costly redesigns needed, just reliable high-speed internet on the go at a budget-friendly price. Available in regional SKUs for global support, including the IK41UC for North America and the IK41VE for Europe.

Intel BE200 IoT Embedded

Built for the field, not the office. This Wi-Fi 7 variant handles an extended temperature range with improved reliability. It delivers the full capability of the standard BE200, adapted for commercial and semi-rugged applications where uptime is critical. Features include MLO (eMLSR), preamble puncturing and 320 MHz channels on the 6 GHz band, all in the compact M.2 2230 form factor.
